labels.R: anomaly: return at doors, wait at thermal gates

doors.prompt: Inspect two NIR camera views of the same arriving car body, left side then right side. Check the four doors: every door must be present, aligned and attached. G = all four doors are visibly present, correctly seated and no detached door is visible. R = a door is visibly missing, hanging loose, displaced from its opening, or fallen beside the body. A = visibility is insufficient or the evidence is uncertain. Output exactly one letter G, A or R. Do not explain or think.

adhesive.prompt: Inspect three monochrome thermal camera closeups of adhesive strips beside future welding spots. Sensor grayscale is linear: black is 20 C, white is 120 C. The illustrative readiness limit is 45 C with a 3 C ambiguity band. G = every strip is visible and its hottest area is below 42 C (grayscale 56 of 255). R = any strip has an area above 48 C (grayscale 71); wait for cooling. A = the hottest strip area is between 42 C and 48 C inclusive, or a strip is hidden, absent or uncertain. Ignore unrelated robot parts and background. Output exactly one letter G, A or R. Do not explain or think.

weld.prompt: Inspect three monochrome thermal camera closeups of completed weld spots on the same car body. Sensor grayscale is linear: black is 20 C, white is 120 C. The illustrative release limit is 55 C with a 3 C ambiguity band. G = every weld spot is visible and its hottest area is below 52 C (grayscale 82 of 255). R = any weld spot has an area above 58 C (grayscale 97); wait for cooling. A = the hottest weld area is between 52 C and 58 C inclusive, or a weld area is hidden, absent or uncertain. Ignore unrelated robot parts and background. Output exactly one letter G, A or R. Do not explain or think.
